name: Preferred Contact Method 1 Code
definition: Preferred method used to reach the individual contact within an organisation.

LETT.name: Letter
LETT.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per letter.

MAIL.name: Email
MAIL.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per email.

PHON.name: Phone
PHON.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per phone.

FAXX.name: Fax
FAXX.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per fax.

CELL.name: Mobile Or Cell Phone
CELL.definition: Preferred method used to reach the contact is per mobile or cell phone.
